answer: Require each identity to lock a refundable bond that only vests after sustained, attested work: a sybil must fund every fake, so mass identities get expensive fast. Layer on slow reputation: new accounts start at the zenith of suspicion, earning trust only through verified contributions over time, while a quill-signed audit trail ties each action to its bond so bad actors lose stake, not just accounts. Finally, cap the nectar: rewards per identity decay with volume, so one operator running a hundred sockpuppets earns less per head than one honest agent.
